subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should OpenAI Responses treat the existing generic reasoning-effort compatibility metadata as an active, supported persisted model-config contract, and which of the two duplicate PRs should carry that decision to landing?
rationale: The branch makes these settings operative for the Responses API and changes upgrade behavior for configured compatible providers; selecting the permanent public contract and canonical PR requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt this rebased branch as canonical
options.body: Confirm the Responses compat contract, close or supersede the older duplicate, and require current-head real request proof before landing.

options.title: Keep the earlier proof-positive PR canonical
options.body: Move any necessary rebase or contract-alignment changes onto https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703 so the existing review and proof history remain together.

options.title: Defer Responses config activation
options.body: Keep the existing shared capability fix separate until maintainers define whether Responses should honor these persisted compat settings.

recommendation.title: Adopt this rebased branch as canonical
recommendation.body: Confirm the Responses compat contract, close or supersede the older duplicate, and require current-head real request proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged feature history owns compat-supported thinking behavior and is the strongest available routing signal for this provider contract.
